reason: I already invest every payday on Robinhood and Public for free, and I can ask Claude about my portfolio whenever I want. I'm not signing up for a monthly fee with no price on it just to have a pet do what my auto-invest already does.
objection: It's a subscription with no price yet, for a real-money version that doesn't exist, through a broker partner nobody has named. Letting an agent move my actual money is a big trust jump, and paying monthly for that is the opposite of how I invest now.
would_change_my_mind: If the real-money version were free or close to it at the base level, ran through a broker I already know, and the agent showed it could actually beat my plain monthly index buys after fees.
